name: Curse of the Soul
source:
Nick was an ordinary schoolboy — quiet, diligent, and honest. His days were spent in the routine of studying, friendly conversations, and dreams of the future. He believed in goodness, honesty, and justice. But everything was shattered on the day his girl, whom he loved, betrayed him. That evening, as darkness was gathering, a mysterious girl appeared to him. She pointed him toward the path of power and darkness. And Nick, having lost everything, made his choice.

[From [url=https://deasfulf.itch.io/the-curse-soul]Itch.io[/url]]
